**How to submit:** Write on paper and show your steps; add the screenshot of Task 2. Upload a clear photo and the screenshot to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 2**.
You may use AI where a task says so. Check its work and say how you used it.

## Task 1 · The grid (2 marks)

The centre of a level is the origin; x goes right and y goes up. A key is 5
units left of the centre and 3 units down.

a) Write the position of the key and its quadrant. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=1 >}}

b) The player is at (2, 4). Write the vector from the player to the key. Use
end − start. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · A patrol, with AI (3 marks)

::: {.callout-note .ai-task title="Task with AI · Plan a patrol"}
A robot starts at (−6, 3) and must reach (6, −5) in 4 frames, with one
velocity per frame.

1. **By hand:** find the velocity and the position after 2 frames.
2. **Ask the AI:** use this prompt, then draw its commands in GeoGebra.

   ::: {.prompt}
   Write GeoGebra commands that draw the positions after frames 0 to 4 of a robot that starts at (−6, 3) and moves with one velocity to reach (6, −5) after 4 frames.
   :::

3. **Check:** is frame 2 where your hand result says? Correct any wrong command.

*Submit:* your steps, a screenshot, and your AI-use statement (tool, prompt,
what you changed).
:::

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}
